    if node.suspended:
        return -1000000.0
    cpu_cap = float(max(node.cpu_capacity, 1))
    mem_cap = float(max(node.mem_capacity, 1))
    cpu_after = float(node.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request) / cpu_cap
    mem_after = float(node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request) / mem_cap

    # admission, is what breaks the SLO here, so the *margin* is what matters.

    weight = 0.0

        destination = ctx.graph.dst[e]

            other = destination
        if destination == pod.id:
            other = source

    target: int,

    for e in range(len(graph.src)):
        source = graph.src[e]
        destination = graph.dst[e]

        source = graph.src[e]
        destination = graph.dst[e]

                        mem_cap = float(max(target.mem_capacity, 1))

                            saving = float(pod.cpu_request) * (source_dynamic / source_cap - target_dynamic / cpu_cap)

                            if empty_source and source.suspendable:
                                saving += source.power_idle_w

        source_index = locations[best_pod]
        out.append(move_pod(pod.id, best_target))
        next_cpu: list[int] = []
        next_memory: list[int] = []
        for n in range(len(state.nodes)):
            cpu_value = cpu[n]
            memory_value = memory[n]
            if n == source_index:
                cpu_value -= pod.cpu_request
                memory_value -= pod.mem_request
            elif n == best_target:
                cpu_value += pod.cpu_request
                memory_value += pod.mem_request
            next_cpu.append(cpu_value)
            next_memory.append(memory_value)
        cpu = next_cpu
        memory = next_memory
        next_locations: list[int] = []
        next_selected: list[bool] = []
        for p in range(len(state.pods)):
            location = locations[p]
            already_selected = selected[p]
            if p == best_pod:
                location = best_target
                already_selected = True
            next_locations.append(location)
            next_selected.append(already_selected)
        locations = next_locations
        selected = next_selected
    return out
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
